rows: Bill To: Service For column when "Open only" is switched

On a payer's Invoices tab, the Service For column shows only when an invoice on the tab is for another customer's work. When the "Open only" switch hides the only such invoice (for example because it is paid), should the Service For column stay or go?
(a) It stays: whether it shows is decided from every invoice of the tab, whatever Open only shows, so the columns do not move.
(b) It goes when no invoice still shown is for someone else, so Date, Type, No. and Memo move.
(c) Something else (please say).

The spec says the column is hidden when no invoice on the tab, before any search, is for someone else; it names the search but not the Open only switch. In the design, adding the column moves Date, Type, No. and Memo sideways (by up to about 90 pixels), so on a live tab the columns would jump each time the switch is used.

Spec: Story 10 (SV-12312), when the Service For column is hidden. The design "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), page 5, pictures "A & J, Invoices" and "Valders, Open only off".
Bill To: Bill To column on the asset's Work Orders tab after filtering

On an asset's Work Orders tab, the Bill To column shows when at least one work order bills someone else. When the Customer filter or the Status filter leaves only work orders that bill their own customer, should the Bill To column stay or go?
(a) It stays: whether it shows is decided from the asset's whole list before any filter, so the columns do not move.
(b) It goes when no work order still shown bills someone else, so every column after it moves.
(c) Something else (please say).

The spec says when the column shows but not whether that is before or after filtering. The design draws no filtered list with the column; on its own pictures, a list with the column and one without it place the later columns 77 to 213 pixels apart. For the Service For column the spec decides it before any search.

Spec: Story 14 (SV-12316), the Bill To column rule and the Customer filter. The design "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), page 7, pictures "Whole history", "One customer picked" and "Work Orders tab, top".
